Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: Oh, hello, dear!
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Oh, hello, dear!
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Oh, hello, dear!

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: Gotta go.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Gotta go.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Gotta go.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: Oh good. You've earned the Shield of Virtue.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Oh good. You've earned the Shield of Virtue.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Oh good. You've earned the Shield of Virtue.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: That's because you showed as much courage and ingenuity as a knight.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: That's because you showed as much courage and ingenuity as a knight.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: That's because you showed as much courage and ingenuity as a knight.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: And the shield is enchanted with the magic of those virtues.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: And the shield is enchanted with the magic of those virtues.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: And the shield is enchanted with the magic of those virtues.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: I'll keep it safe for now. In the meantime, you have more items to locate.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: I'll keep it safe for now. In the meantime, you have more items to locate.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: I'll keep it safe for now. In the meantime, you have more items to locate.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: I opened the door to the next chamber. Go see <Lore>Fauna</Lore> for a test of your kindness and truth.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: I opened the door to the next chamber. Go see <Lore>Fauna</Lore> for a test of your kindness and truth.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: I opened the door to the next chamber. Go see <Lore>Fauna</Lore> for a test of your kindness and truth.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: Have you found the dragon's flame and the knight's arms yet?
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Have you found the dragon's flame and the knight's arms yet?
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Have you found the dragon's flame and the knight's arms yet?

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: Once you have, just put them back where they belong.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Jakmile to uděláte, prostě je vraťte tam, kam patří.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Jakmile to uděláte, prostě je vraťte tam, kam patří.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: Watch the shadows, dear.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Sleduj stíny, drahoušku.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Sleduj stíny, drahoušku.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: They hold the key to protecting the brave knight from the dragon's flame.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Drží klíč k ochraně statečného rytíře před dračím plamenem.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Drží klíč k ochraně statečného rytíře před dračím plamenem.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: Watch the shadows, dear.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Sleduj stíny, drahoušku.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Sleduj stíny, drahoušku.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: You found the Shield of Virtue?
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Našel jsi Štít ctnosti?
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Našel jsi Štít ctnosti?

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: Let me see.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Ukaž mi to.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Ukaž mi to.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: There you are, dear!
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Tak tady to máš, drahoušku!
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Tak tady to máš, drahoušku!

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: I was beginning to wonder if you'd ever arrive.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Začínal jsem si říkat, jestli vůbec dorazíš.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Začínal jsem si říkat, jestli vůbec dorazíš.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: How can you be here when you were also over there?
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Jak můžeš být tady, když jsi byl taky tam?
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Jak můžeš být tady, když jsi byl taky tam?

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: It's easy to get lost in here.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Je snadné se tu ztratit.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Je snadné se tu ztratit.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: What do I need to do?
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Co musím udělat?
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Co musím udělat?

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: Oh, we fairies have lots of talents.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Ach, my víly máme spoustu talentů.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Ach, my víly máme spoustu talentů.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: Being wherever we need to be is just one of them.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Být tam, kde potřebujeme být, je jen jednou z nich.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Být tam, kde potřebujeme být, je jen jednou z nich.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: But never mind that; we have work to do.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Ale na to nevadí, máme co dělat.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Ale na to nevadí, máme co dělat.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: Do you see that <Lore>great dragon</Lore> over there?
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Vidíš tam toho <Lore>velkého draka</Lore>?
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Vidíš tam toho <Lore>velkého draka</Lore>?

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: Dragon?! Where?! Aghhh!
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Drak?! Kde?! Ááá!
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Drak?! Kde?! Ááá!

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: What do I need to do with it?
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Co s tím mám dělat?
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Co s tím mám dělat?

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: Oh, don't be such a fraidy-cat. It's just a practice dummy, so the castle guards can learn to fight dragons.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Nebuď takový bázlivec. Je to jen cvičná figurína, aby se hradní stráže naučily bojovat s draky.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Nebuď takový bázlivec. Je to jen cvičná figurína, aby se hradní stráže naučily bojovat s draky.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: Do you have a lot of dragon attacks?
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Máš hodně dračích útoků?
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Máš hodně dračích útoků?

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: What do I need to do with it?
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Co s tím mám dělat?
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Co s tím mám dělat?

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: No. But Maleficent's lurking about, so we have to be prepared.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Ne. Ale Zloba se tu potuluje, takže musíme být připraveni.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Ne. Ale Zloba se tu potuluje, takže musíme být připraveni.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: To obtain the <ActivityItem>Shield of Virtue</ActivityItem>, you'll have to find what's missing here.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Abyste získali <ActivityItem>Štít ctnosti</ActivityItem>, budete muset najít, co zde chybí.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Abyste získali <ActivityItem>Štít ctnosti</ActivityItem>, budete muset najít, co zde chybí.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: The poor knight has <Lore>misplaced his arm</Lore>.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Chudák rytíř si <Lore>ztratil ruku</Lore>.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Chudák rytíř si <Lore>ztratil ruku</Lore>.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: And a dragon's not a dragon <Lore>without its flame</Lore>.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: A drak není drak <Lore>bez plamene</Lore>.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: A drak není drak <Lore>bez plamene</Lore>.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: Once you've made it a fair fight, you'll have to help the virtuous knight battle the deadly dragon.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Jakmile si z boje uděláte spravedlivý souboj, budete muset pomoci ctnostnému rytíři v boji se smrtícím drakem.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Jakmile si z boje uděláte spravedlivý souboj, budete muset pomoci ctnostnému rytíři v boji se smrtícím drakem.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: <Lore>Look at their shadows.</Lore> They'll help you know where to place them.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: <Lore>Podívejte se na jejich stíny.</Lore> Pomohou vám vědět, kam je umístit.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: <Lore>Podívejte se na jejich stíny.</Lore> Pomohou vám vědět, kam je umístit.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: Oh, but I like getting lost sometimes.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Ale občas se rád ztratím.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Ale občas se rád ztratím.

Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.en: It's the best way to find interesting things.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.cz: Je to nejlepší způsob, jak najít zajímavé věci.
Expansion02Part2_MerryweatherStainedGlas.original_cz: Je to nejlepší způsob, jak najít zajímavé věci.
